newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror files $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror files $500 mln shelf.

text.p: Times Mirror Co filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $500 million in liquid yield option notes due 2017 that may be offered periodically by several shareholders.

The LYONS had been issued by the company in April and also as part of a February indenture, according to the SEC filing. The latest filing would allow shareholders who had already been issued the LYONS to offer them.
The company will not receive any of the proceeds from any potential sales.
No underwriters were named in the filing.
